name: @dotdotgod/pi
description: Pi adapter for dotdotgod: project-initializer skill, shared docs scaffold, plan/archive workflow, and project loading extensions.

scripts.syntax: node --check extensions/shared/dotdotgod-cli.ts && node --check extensions/shared/workflow-coordination.ts && node --check extensions/subagents/index.ts && node --check extensions/context-metrics/utils.ts && node --check extensions/load-project/index.ts && node --check extensions/load-project/utils.ts && node --check extensions/plan-mode/index.ts && node --check extensions/plan-mode/utils.ts && node --check extensions/plan-generator/index.ts && node --check extensions/plan-generator/plan-files.ts && node --check extensions/plan-generator/questions.ts && node --check extensions/plan-generator/stage-contract.ts && node --check extensions/plan-generator/store.ts && node --check extensions/plan-generator/utils.ts
scripts.check:resources: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const req=['skills/project-initializer/SKILL.md','skills/project-initializer/agents/openai.yaml','skills/project-initializer/scripts/init_project.sh','skills/document-clarify/SKILL.md','skills/document-clarify/agents/openai.yaml','extensions/subagents/index.ts']; for (const f of req) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('missing '+f); } const cli=require.resolve('@dotdotgod/cli/bin/dotdotgod.mjs'); const subagentsRoot=path.dirname(require.resolve('pi-subagents/package.json')); for (const f of [cli,path.join(subagentsRoot,'src/extension/index.ts'),path.join(subagentsRoot,'skills/pi-subagents/SKILL.md'),path.join(subagentsRoot,'prompts/parallel-review.md')]) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('missing '+f); } console.log('pi resources ok')"
scripts.verify: pnpm run syntax && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:resources
